ambient_events: Somebody racks a bar too hard and the whole rack rings like a bell.
A skipping rope ticks against the concrete in a fast, even count, then stops.
The ring ropes creak as somebody leans on them to get their breath back.
A radio on the office sill loses the station, finds it, and loses it again.
description: One long room, concrete floor, iron columns down the middle holding up the floor above. Two benches stand under the windows with a rack of plates between them, none of which match. Down the far end the conditioning circuit is laid out in chalk: tyres to flip, a sled to drag and a rope off the joist for anyone who wants it worse. The ring takes up the middle, canvas grey with age and patched. A board by the office door lists the house rules, the first of which is RE-RACK YOUR WEIGHTS.

window.description: A row of steel-framed windows propped open on sticks. The street comes in through them with the air, and so does the noise.
window.name: the propped windows
